structural.note: amaretto is an almond (nut) liqueur, not a fruit liqueur; its own alias is 'almond liqueur'. fruit-liqueur is the wrong base — reparent to the generic liqueur.
id 'aromatic' is a bare modifier that mis-reads as a generic token; name is already 'aromatic bitters'. No items reference 'aromatic' as a parent, so reid is safe.
id 'gold' is extremely bare (color word) for an item named 'gold cachaça'. No items reference 'gold' as a parent, so reid is safe.

cleanups.note: 'pale ale' is duplicated on beer and on its child 'ale' (where pale/brown/amber ale + ipa live). A pale-ale query should resolve to the specific child, not the generic beer parent.
'cooking sherry' is duplicated on cooking-wine and on 'sherry'. Cooking sherry is genuinely sherry; it should resolve to the sherry item, not generic salted cooking wine.
bare 'creme' is over-broad — it exact-matches the common dairy query path for 'cream'/'crème fraîche' (Dairy & Eggs) rather than meaning liqueur. 'creme liqueur' (kept) is the unambiguous form.
